fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (39.012236,-96.289857) landed near the correct block; the plant proper is at ~39.0110,-96.2879. Real address is 110/114 E First St, Alma KS 66401 (geocoded as 215 Missouri St in roster). Confirmed via Street View - a metal industrial plant with office annex, process equipment and trailers in a small-town industrial pocket.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, gate, or controlled checkpoint. The site is open to the gravel town streets; vehicles park right up to the buildings and a residential house sits across the street. truckGateCount=1 reflects the single open driveway access, not a controlled gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth anywhere on site - small open small-town facility.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Modest dock count - a few dock doors with trailers backed in along the south/SW building faces. Estimated 0-10 band (~7). Low confidence from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropYard: ~8-9 trailers parked in an angled row in the south yard along the rail line, plus 2-3 scattered trailers near the docks. Small drop yard, 0-10 band.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the SE edge of the property but no spur crosses onto the site. Not rail-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Alma, KS is a small Flint Hills town (~800 population). Edge-of-town small-town industrial setting - Rural.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Short open driveway access from the gravel street; only room for 1-2 trucks to approach the dock.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main processing building plus 2-3 connected/adjacent secondary buildings (office annex, dark-roofed shop/warehouse buildings) - treated as one facility, not a campus.
